title: Finite-stage geometric and coefficient hypotheses for ordinary exceptional comparison
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum of [def-pur-conventions]: $k$ is the fixed algebraic closure of a finite field of characteristic $p$, $\ell\ne p$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Neither scheme is required to be separated over $k$.

The schemes $X,Y$ are Noetherian, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. There is a compactification $c=(j,r)$ with $j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X$ a quasi-compact open immersion, $r:\overline X\to Y$ proper and $rj=f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. For every such compactification, $\overline X$ is a finite-type Noetherian $k$-scheme and there is an integer $D\geq0$ with $\dim\overline X\leq D$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. If $\overline X$ is empty, $D=0$ is allowed.

The ring $A$ is finite and the positive integer $N=\ell^n$ satisfies $NA=0$; $N$ is invertible on every $k$-scheme. These conclusions also hold for every separated finite-type $k$-morphism obtained by a Cartesian base change between finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. In particular, when $f$ is smooth of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], the Noetherian, finite coefficient, invertible annihilator and compactifiability hypotheses for the ordinary etale smooth tensor theorem hold, as do the finite-dimensional compactification hypotheses for the bounded-below etale-origin exceptional Hom comparison.

proof.text: A field is Noetherian: its only ideals are $(0)$ and $(1)$. Thus $\operatorname{Spec}k$ is Noetherian. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] to the structure morphisms of $X$ and $Y$. Both schemes are Noetherian, hence locally Noetherian and quasi-compact by the definition in that lemma. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated] to obtain quasi-separatedness of both. These applications require no separatedness of either structure morphism.

Apply [thm-nagata-compactification] after Step 1 has supplied compactness and quasi-separatedness of Y. For every compactification c, properness of c.g gives local finite type and quasi-compactness by [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Compose with aY by [lem-sfb-finite-type-composition-base-change]. The same argument as Step 1 gives Noetherianity of c.Z. The existing Compactification.quasiCompact_openImmersion lemma gives quasi-compactness of c.i directly from quasi-compactness of f: its proof uses QuasiCompact.of_comp on c.i followed by c.g, whose composite is f.

source.place: Tag 0F41 (theorem-nagata); morphisms.tex Tags 01W1 and 01T3; schemes.tex Tag 03GI

proof.text: Apply the recorded declaration AlgebraicGeometry.exists_topologicalKrullDim_le of [lem-kun-dimension-finite-type] directly to c.g followed by aY. Its conclusion is exactly a natural-number upper bound on topologicalKrullDim c.Z of [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. It already includes the empty scheme, where the dimension is bottom. No translation from a separate scheme dimension is needed.

Apply Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing, the finite-ring interface recorded on [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], at the given positive level. For annihilation, unfold the recorded coefficient data, and use [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr] to identify its maximal ideal by absolute value less than one and its uniformizer span with that ideal. By spectralNorm_extends of [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-absolute-value] and Padic.norm_p_lt_one of [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], ell belongs to the maximal ideal. Ideal.pow_mem_pow puts ell^n in its nth power, which is the defining coefficient ideal. Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem makes the natural-number cast zero in A. Finally nsmul_eq_mul gives ell^n times every a equal to zero. This uses no ramification divisibility hypothesis.

source.place: First paragraph, finite coefficient stage; coefficient facts as stated in def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension and its cited valuation and quotient lemmas

proof.text: The prime ell is at least one, so ell^n is at least one. For any k-scheme T, apply the existing coefficientPrime_isUnit_stalk theorem of [def-pur-conventions], whose proof uses characteristic p and ell different from p, at every point of T. Raise those units to the nth power. The ringed-space theorem isUnit_of_isUnit_germ proves that the section ell^n is a unit. This also applies to the empty scheme, since the sheaf unit criterion has no nonemptiness hypothesis.

source.place: First paragraph, finite coefficient stage; elementary characteristic-p verification of invertibility

proof.text: The chosen Cartesian square identifies f′ with its specified isomorphism to the pullback followed by pullback.snd f g. The base-change and composition instances of [lem-pod-separated-finite-type-base-change] and [lem-sfb-finite-type-composition-base-change] supply separatedness, local finite type and quasi-compactness of f′, and local finite type and quasi-compactness of f′ followed by aY′. Apply the same private geometric lemma implementing Steps 1--3 to this composite and aY′. The coefficient conclusions of Steps 4--5 are unchanged. The smooth specialization needs no additional construction.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q160-8dc394e17 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item and all six steps in full. The statement is unchanged from base and there are no new nodes. I checked the item against the actual hypotheses of both targets. thm-asd-smooth-tensor needs a finite commutative A, an integer N with NA=0, a Noetherian base on which N is invertible, and a compactifiable f in the sense of def-asd-compactifiable (open immersion plus proper); the item supplies all of these. thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class needs a compactification as in def-weil-compactifications-refinements with an integer bound on dim of the compactification; the item supplies this for every compactification. The coefficient ring is A_{E,n} of def-pur-conventions throughout. Neither target nor the parent is reachable from the item's dependencies, so there is no cycle. Step 1: Spec k is Noetherian; 01T6 and 01OY give Noetherian and quasi-separated without any separatedness. Step 2: Nagata (0F41, base only qcqs) gives the compactification; proper implies finite type, composition makes the compactification finite type over k and Noetherian, and permanence (03GI) makes j quasi-compact. Step 4: |l|=1/l<1 puts l in m_E=(uniformizer); then l=uniformizer*b gives l^n=0 in A, and the finite-quotients lemma gives finiteness. I tested this on E=Q_l, a totally ramified E and an unramified E. Step 5 is elementary since l differs from p. Step 6 uses base-change permanence (01KU, 01T3, 01T4) and repeats Steps 1-3. One repair, in Step 3: lem-kun-dimension-finite-type bounds kundim, which is defined in def-kun-dimension, but the step identified it with def-kun-topological-krull-dimension without citing def-kun-dimension. I rewrote Step 3 to cite def-kun-dimension and state the identification (the same supremum over chains), and added def-kun-dimension to the step's uses and to proof_deps. The fix is the whole node file at fixes/dag/nodes/sec-smooth-purity/. I accept the declared tool uses (Nagata, the absolute-value lemma and the DVR lemma). There are no SGA citations and no repair note for this item.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
